Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
Good news! Your order (#@OrderNumber@) has shipped. Here’s the tracking number and your order details.
Carrier: @OrderShippingDetail.Carrier@
Tracking Number: @OrderShippingDetail.TrackingNumber@
Shipping to:
@ShipTo.SiteName@
@ShipTo.Name@
@Shipping.Address@
If you have any questions about your shipment, our customer care team is happy to help.
Call us Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214. You can also reach us by email at CustomerService@dm-us.com.
Thank you for choosing Dynamic Media. Enjoy your music!
The Dynamic Media Team
